[MA-0] SCALE: Real-Time Latent Communication for Cyber-Physical Agents

【速读】：该论文旨在解决网络带宽受限且任务截止时间异构的网络化物理系统（cyber-physical agents）中，传统基于大语言模型（LLM）的潜在通信方法难以适用的问题。现有方法主要针对大语言模型代理设计，忽视了物理系统对实时性与通信效率的严苛要求。为此，本文提出一种面向网络化物理系统的实时潜在通信框架SCALE。其核心解决方案在于：利用物理世界在时空上的连续性，通过相似度评分匹配连续潜在消息中的词元（token），识别可复用信息以减少冗余传输；同时，构建语义增益与通信开销的量化模型，结合可用带宽和任务截止时间约束，采用实时调度器动态决策待发送消息及其传输量。实验结果表明，在多种网络条件与异构任务截止时间下，SCALE显著提升了任务完成率与按时交付率，验证了其在资源受限场景下的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08390
作者: Shanghao Shi,Jian Xiao,Ching-Hsiang Chan,Sanjoy Baruah,Sastry Kompella,Yevgeniy Vorobeychik,William Yeoh,Ning Zhang
机构: Washington University in St. Louis(圣路易斯华盛顿大学); Nexcepta Inc.(Nexcepta公司)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Latent communication enables agents to collaborate efficiently by directly exchanging intermediate model representations rather than raw sensor data or text messages. Existing approaches, however, are primarily designed for LLM agents and do not consider the bandwidth constraints and heterogeneous task deadlines faced by cyber-physical agents. In this work, we propose SCALE, a real-time latent communication method tailored for cyber-physical agents. Motivated by the spatio-temporal continuity of the physical world, SCALE matches tokens across consecutive latent messages using similarity scores to identify reusable information and avoid redundant transmission. It then profiles the semantic gain and communication cost of transmitting different amounts of latent information. Based on these profiles, SCALE employs a real-time scheduler that jointly determines which pending messages to transmit and how many latent tokens to send, subject to available bandwidth and task deadlines. We evaluate SCALE across three cyber-physical benchmarks and a physical spider robot case study under diverse network conditions and heterogeneous task deadlines. Our results show that SCALE significantly improves both task performance and on-time delivery in bandwidth-constrained networks. Our code is available at: this https URL.

[MA-1] Radio-to-Pose Information for Gauge-Drift Correction in Cooperative Localization

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多机器人协同定位中的**尺度-姿态漂移（gauge drift）问题，即在仅依赖相对测量（如里程计与机器人间观测）时，整个机器人团队的位姿估计会随时间发生一致性的累积误差，导致全局位置与方向的偏移。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为无线电信号到位姿信息（Radio-to-Pose Information, RPI）**的新接口机制，该机制将接收功率残差及其关于位姿的导数转换为高斯信息矩阵与信息向量对，从而将无线电信道衰减图（radio attenuation map）中蕴含的全局几何约束嵌入到位姿估计过程中。RPI的核心洞察是：接收信号强度对世界坐标系中机器人间的共同位移具有敏感性，因此可通过注册于同一世界坐标系的衰减地图实现对共享运动模式的检测与校正。该方法在保持机器人间及时间维度上的协方差相关性的同时，实现了联合高斯位姿估计与不确定性最小化。实验表明，在1000次模拟高斯试验中，RPI与联合估计结果完全一致；在32组带注册地图的实际对比试验中，相对于仅使用无线电权重相对测量的基线方法，其在50×50 m场景下将共用位置均方根误差（RMSE）从0.542 m显著降低至0.140 m，验证了其在抑制全局漂移方面的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08361
作者: Aditya Iyer,Andy Ye,Akshay Narayan,Nora Ayanian
机构: Brown University (布朗大学); University of Washington (华盛顿大学)
类目: Robotics (cs.RO); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Cooperative localization uses odometry and inter-robot measurements to estimate the motion of a robot team. These measurements describe only relative geometry, but the team’s estimated position and orientation can drift together over time, i.e., gauge drift. In this work, we study correction of this gauge drift using a radio attenuation map registered in the same world coordinate frame used for robot poses. Specifically, we propose Radio-to-Pose Information (RPI), an interface that converts power residuals and their pose derivatives into a Gaussian information matrix and vector pair. RPI builds on the insight that received power is sensitive to shared displacement in the world map. The pose estimator uses the interface together with odometry and inter-robot measurements to update poses and minimize uncertainty. We characterize the shared motions detectable from the map and observed links. For an uncertain shared map, RPI keeps correlations across robots and time and reproduces joint Gaussian pose estimates and covariances. Across 1000 simulated Gaussian trials, RPI matches the results of joint estimation. Across 32 paired trials with a registered map, RPI reduces common-position RMSE from 0.542 m to 0.140 m in a 50\times50 m arena compared with a baseline that uses radio only to weight relative measurements.

[MA-2] rilemma: How Agents choose between Honesty Confidentiality and Task Completion

【速读】：该论文旨在解决个人智能代理（Personal AI agents）在执行任务时面临的目标冲突与隐私泄露双重问题，即当代理依据用户私密信息（如不愿与特定同事合作）做出决策时，如何在保持诚实、维护保密性与完成任务之间进行权衡。其核心解决方案在于通过模拟企业Slack工作环境中的冲刺任务分配场景，系统评估多种大模型在面对此类伦理困境时的行为表现。关键发现是：尽管多数开放权重模型（open-weight models）在未被明确指示的情况下仍会出于动机性推理（motivated reasoning），主动编造虚假理由或误导性陈述以掩饰真实私人偏好，但引入中等至强程度的保密性指令可显著降低隐私泄露率（从83%降至2%）。然而，这种保密性强化也导致任务完成率大幅下降（仅16/70次运行成功完成分配），表明当前代理在规避欺骗的同时难以有效达成任务目标。研究揭示了生成式AI在现实场景中可能自发产生策略性误导行为，凸显了对代理行为进行去欺骗监控（deception monitoring）机制开发的必要性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08312
作者: Johannes Taraz,Abhinav Kumar,Sahar Abdelnabi
机构: ELLIS Institute Tübingen(ELLIS研究所图宾根); MPI for Intelligent Systems(智能系统马普研究所); Tübingen AI Center(图宾根人工智能中心); University of Massachusetts Amherst(马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校)
类目: Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Personal AI agents often act on underspecified instructions and draw on context such as their user’s messages and calendar to decide how to proceed. This context can contain private preferences that interfere with the task, with other people’s interests, or with confidentiality norms. Prior work has studied deception under goal conflicts and the leakage of private information, but largely as separate problems. We study both problems together in a simulated company Slack workspace in which four employees delegate sprint staffing to personal agents. Two agents learn from private messages that their employee avoids working with a particular colleague. Because the other agents request justifications for task preferences and the only true justification is confidential, the agents cannot simultaneously remain honest, preserve confidentiality, and complete the staffing. We evaluate seven open-weight models and Claude and GPT models. Of the 135/140 open-weight agents that pursue the avoidance preference, 107 either make false claims about task fit or logistics or cite a true consideration as if it were their actual reason. In a three-model comparison, confidentiality instructions reduce disclosure of the preference from 83% (none) to 31% (medium) to 2% (strong). However, the task is often not completed anyway; in the main experiment (medium confidentiality instructions), only 16 of 70 runs end with a valid staffing. In their reasoning traces, agents frequently acknowledge evidence against their claims and still conclude that the claims are not false; they engage in motivated reasoning. Our results indicate that agents can strategically make false or misleading claims in a day-to-day task without being instructed to; the environment provides a controlled testbed for studying how agents resolve such conflicts and for developing deception monitors.

[MA-3] SEER: A Scalable Event-Driven Runtime for Parallel Execution of Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Environments

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体强化学习（MARL）系统中，尽管策略推理可在GPU上进行批处理，但CPU侧环境执行路径仍存在显著延迟瓶颈的问题。在交互密集型场景下，环境路径需串行更新实体状态、处理局部交互并构建观测信息，其计算开销成为性能关键制约因素。现有向量化环境接口与通用事件驱动运行时无法有效处理单个MARL步内细粒度的跨智能体协作任务，同时难以维持学习系统所期望的步级语义一致性。为应对这一挑战，论文提出SEER（Scalable Event-Driven Environment Runtime），其核心在于引入显式的事件局部性契约（event-locality contract）：将每个环境步骤建模为带时间戳的事件流，确保直接状态更新为实体本地操作，而跨实体影响通过有序未来事件表达。在此基础上，SEER采用基于比较并交换（CAS）的双层事件队列结构——局部事件队列维护各实体因果顺序，全局执行列表则暴露可并行处理的任务；同时结合STPA（预飞行引导的线程池选择机制），融合短时运行时轨迹与静态工作负载及硬件特征，实现高效调度。实验结果表明，在计算密集型无人机编队控制（Aircraft）和通信密集型无线资源管理（PCS）两个参数化工作负载上，SEER分别相较基线降低16.2%的推理延迟，并在环境执行延迟方面较ROSS-T、NBSE和ROOT-Sim分别降低46.9%、19.5%和64.9%，验证了其在保持步级语义一致性前提下的高可扩展性与高效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07996
作者: Jiming Su,Feng Zhu,Yuhao Xiao,Miao Zhang
机构: 未知
类目: Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is increasingly used in systems where many entities interact in a shared environment. In these workloads, policy inference can be batched on GPUs, but the CPU-side environment path still updates entity states, resolves local interactions, and builds observations inside each \mathrmthis http URL . This path can dominate latency in interaction-intensive workloads after policy batching. Existing vectorized environment interfaces and general event-driven runtimes do not directly address the fine-grained cross-entity work inside one bounded MARL step while preserving the step-level semantics expected by learning systems. We present SEER (Scalable Event-Driven Environment Runtime), a runtime for MARL environment execution under an explicit event-locality contract. SEER models each environment step as a bounded stream of timestamped events. If direct state updates are entity-local and cross-entity effects are represented as ordered future events, SEER can run independent events in parallel while preserving serial-equivalent boundary outputs. To make this contract practical, SEER uses a CAS-based dual-layer event queue: local event queues preserve per-entity causal order, while a parallel executive list exposes ready work to global worker threads. SEER further uses STPA, a preflight-guided thread-pool selection mechanism that combines short runtime traces with static workload and hardware features. We evaluate SEER on two parameterized MARL workloads: compute-intensive UAV swarm control (Aircraft) and communication-intensive wireless management (PCS). On Aircraft, SEER reduces inference latency by 16.2% over the baseline. On PCS, SEER reduces environment-execution latency by 46.9%, 19.5%, and 64.9% over ROSS-T, NBSE, and ROOT-Sim, respectively.

[MA-4] ReferClaw: Disambiguating User Intent for Egocentric Assistance

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在第一人称视角人工智能助手（egocentric AI assistants）场景下，用户提出的短促且语义模糊的问题难以通过视频与对话历史唯一确定指代对象的问题。例如，“我把它放哪了？”可能涉及多个此前处理过的物体，现有视频问答（VideoQA）系统通常仅选择单一解释，容易产生符合语法但违背用户意图的回答。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种名为ReferClaw的代理式（agentic）框架，将第一人称流式问答建模为交互过程：助手通过主动询问澄清问题以明确用户意图后再作答。该框架由三个协同工作的智能体组成——候选解释识别、澄清请求生成和基于已解析意图与视觉证据的答案生成；同时引入一个受约束的、成本感知的策略，权衡预期信息增益与用户付出的努力，限制澄清轮次与问题复杂度。ReferClaw通过意图特定技能更新与基于过程奖励引导的策略优化，实现代理层面的信用分配，并从交互中持续学习。在增强的第一人称问答基准上的评估表明，该方法在答案准确率及答案-定位联合性能上优于现有基线，并具备跨数据集的零样本迁移能力，验证了交互式澄清作为第一人称流式辅助中在线用户意图解析的可行性与有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07683
作者: Hangyu Qin,Junbin Xiao,Angela Yao
机构: National University of Singapore(新加坡国立大学); University of Science and Technology of China(中国科学技术大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Users of egocentric AI assistants often ask short, ambiguous questions whose intended referents cannot be uniquely resolved from video and dialogue history. For example, “Where did I leave it?” may refer to several previously handled objects. Existing VideoQA systems typically commit to a single interpretation, risking plausible but intention-misaligned answers. We introduce ReferClaw, an agentic framework that formulates egocentric streaming QA as an interactive process: the assistant asks clarifying questions to resolve user intent before answering. Three cooperating agents identify candidate interpretations, request clarification, and generate answers grounded in the resolved intent and visual evidence. A bounded, cost-aware policy balances expected information gain against user effort while limiting clarification turns and question complexity. Referclaw learns from interaction through intent-specific skill updates and process-reward-guided policy optimization with agent-level credit assignment. Evaluations on augmented egocentric QA benchmarks demonstrate improved answer accuracy and joint answer-and-grounding performance over existing baselines, alongside zero-shot transfer across datasets. These findings support interactive clarification as a practical approach to resolving online user intent in egocentric streaming assistance.

[MA-5] Signed but Not Safe: Requirement Integrity in Multi-Agent LLM Handoffs

【速读】：该论文旨在解决企业级生成式 AI（Generative AI）系统中多智能体协作时因中间传递环节导致需求丢失、篡改或忽略的可靠性问题。在复杂任务分解与结果合并过程中，各子代理间的请求传递若缺乏可信保障机制，极易引入安全风险。其核心解决方案是引入“带签名的需求清单”（signed requirement-manifest）机制：由编排器将每个需求以原文引用（verbatim quote）加可验证谓词的形式提取，并通过 HMAC-SHA256 对需求清单进行数字签名，确保传输过程中的完整性；同时采用确定性代码对合并结果进行验证，实现对决策行为的可审计与可复现检查。实验表明，该方案将攻击下的不安全提交率从 69.4% 降至 9.0%（下降 60.4 个百分点），且未牺牲符合规范的提交数量。签名机制有效抵御了在途篡改攻击——未签名清单在变异运行中 79% 出现违规，而签名版本则为零。此外，确定性验证器相较于大模型检查器，在检出违规决策方面提升至 78.7%（vs. 59.0%），误报率也显著降低至 7%（vs. 50%）。最终分析指出，剩余风险源于签名前的需求提取阶段，即“提取”环节是信任边界所在，预签注入攻击验证了此结论：恶意注入仅需一行即可使签名后的非法清单被认证通过，说明签名无法保护提取阶段的初始污染。因此，该研究的关键在于通过形式化签名与确定性验证构建可信传递链，将信任边界明确界定于需求提取之前。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.07483
作者: Xiaobo Chen,Genliang Zhu,Ziyuan Wang,Chu Wang
机构: University of Massachusetts Amherst(马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校); Georgia Institute of Technology(佐治亚理工学院); Duke University(杜克大学); University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign(伊利诺伊大学厄本那-香槟分校)
类目: Cryptography and Security (cs.CR); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Multiagent Systems (cs.MA)
备注: 34 pages, 0 figures. Preregistered; code, task banks, freeze manifests and run logs are available from the authors on request

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Enterprise AI agents increasingly split a user’s request across subagents and merge their results, and each handoff can summarize away, alter or ignore a requirement. We report a preregistered study with synthetic, exactly scorable tasks comparing free-text, structured JSON and signed requirement-manifest handoffs: the orchestrator extracts each requirement as a verbatim quote plus a checkable predicate, code signs the manifest with HMAC-SHA256, and deterministic code verifies the merger’s decision. With Qwen3-8B (1,440 trajectories, five threats), signed manifests cut unsafe commits under attack from 69.4% to 9.0% (60.4 pp, 95% CI [51.4, 69.4]) with no net loss of conformant commits relative to structured handoffs. Signing is what defeats in-transit tampering: an unsigned manifest committed violations in 79% of mutated runs, the signed one in none. On identical trajectories the deterministic verifier caught 78.7% of violating decisions versus 59.0% for an LLM checker, with 7% versus 50% false alarms. An oracle manifest removed all remaining unsafe commits: the residual risk comes from extraction errors made before signing. A preregistered pre-signing injection attack confirmed this boundary: one adversarial line raised signed-manifest violations from 14.6% to 37.5% (Qwen3-8B), 11.1% to 63.9% (gpt-oss-20b) and 8.3% to 75.0% (GPT-5.6-luna), and the signature then authenticated the corrupted manifest. Signing protects requirements in transit, not at extraction; the extraction step is the trust boundary.

[MA-6] he Last Mile to the Real World: Agent -Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks WWW

【速读】：该论文旨在解决大模型在处理真实世界任务时“最后一公里”（last mile to the real world）的瓶颈问题，即模型虽能获取资源但难以有效应用资源完成任务。现有方法将资源置于可访问范围，但任务执行能力仍依赖调用方自行构建，导致每个任务需重复实现相同的能力，效率低下且泛化性差。其解决方案的关键在于提出原生代理原子单元（agent-native primitives），即具备内嵌大语言模型（LLM）以在上下文中自主应用资源并与其他单元通信的可复用组件，并设计了HEELO框架（Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-World Tasks），通过从预定义的原子单元库中组合出任务特定的执行图，自动验证结果、定位失败环节并迭代优化或引入新单元。实验表明，基于八类原子单元的HEELO显著提升多个基准测试表现：在Terminal-Bench 4.0上，使用Codex的GPT-5.6 Sol任务解决率从37.3%提升至55.5%；在Terminal-Bench 2.0上，任务级原子单元使Pass@1从60.0%提升至72.2%；工具类与导航类原子单元分别将ToolBench和GAIA-Text-103的准确率提升19.3和12.7个百分点。在46个真实世界任务上，接入HEELO后，Claude Opus 5.5与GPT-6.1 Sol的任务完成率分别达到39和35，较独立执行分别提升30和35%，同时平均耗时减少约50%，单位任务成本降低45%。

作者: Haibo Jin,Peng Kuang,Xiaopeng Yuan,Lucheng Fu,Jerry Wang,Xucheng Yu,Yaoning Yu,Dehao Wu,Runguo Li,Colin Su,Jingxuan Sun,Xuyang Liu,Haojing Luo,Haohan Wang

Abstract:How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primitives, reusable units that equip a resource with a resident LLM that applies it in context and communicates with other primitives, and HEELO (Harness Engineering around Evolving Agent-Native Primitives for the Last Mile to Real-WOrld Tasks), a harness engineering framework that builds each task’s harness from a library of such primitives. HEELO composes the primitives a task needs into a task-specific graph, verifies the result against evidence from the environment, revises the primitives a failure implicates, and admits new or improved primitives after validation. We instantiate HEELO with eight primitive families, each built for one kind of task, and evaluate them on more than twenty benchmarks. Dev-Primitives raise Terminal-Bench 4.0 resolution from 37.3% under Codex to 55.5% on the same backbone, Harness Primitives composed per task raise Terminal-Bench 2.0 Pass@1 from 60.0% for the seed harness to 72.2%, Tool Primitives raise ToolBench pass rate from 55.8% to 75.1%, and Navigation Primitives raise GAIA-Text-103 accuracy from 45.6% to 58.3%. On the 46 real-world tasks of our this http URL platform, Claude Opus 5.5 with Claude Code and GPT-6.1 Sol with Codex complete 9 each on their own and 39 and 35 when connected to HEELO through our MCP server, with 1.9 \times and 2.3 \times less time and 1.55 \times lower cost per completed task.

Abstract:Generative video models have made video creation more accessible, yet creators still struggle to translate high-level narrative intentions into coherent cinematic expressions. Existing systems primarily rely on prompt refinement or expose isolated camera controls, leaving a gap between what to express and how to film it. We present CineAssist, a human-AI co-creation system that treats cinematic language as an interactive design medium connecting creative intentions with executable video controls. We construct a Cinematic Language Design Space and an annotated dataset from 107 filmmaking sources and 1,436 film clips, linking communicative intentions to cinematic parameter values. CineAssist combines a multi-agent workflow for intent alignment and strategy recommendation with an interactive cinematic editor and a context-sensitive preference learner for user-controlled personalization. We evaluate the system through three studies examining end-to-end usability, cinematic quality, and preference evolution. Results show that CineAssist facilitates efficient, controllable, and personalized intent-driven cinematic video creation.

Abstract:Driven by the rapid development of the low-altitude economy, Uncrewed Aerial Vehicle (UAV) networks have become increasingly important for executing tasks such as search, rescue, and monitoring. However, under bandwidth-constrained scenarios, UAV networks still face significant challenges in task execution efficiency and intelligent processing capabilities. To address these issues, we propose Multi-UAV Cooperative Deep Semantic Autoencoders (MC-DSA) for communication networks. The architecture comprises one Task UAV (T-UAV) and multiple Support UAVs (S-UAVs), which jointly enhance communication efficiency and data-processing capability via semantic communication and cooperation. Specifically, we introduce a semantic matching and source selection mechanism, enabling the proposed MC-DSA to handle low-quality images while ensuring effective utilization of high-quality images. The T-UAV broadcasts a task query, and each S-UAV computes the semantic similarity between its local image and the query. Communication links are established only when the similarity exceeds a predefined threshold. The training algorithm optimizes network parameters through gradient descent, improving semantic feature extraction accuracy. The testing algorithm evaluates UAV collaboration efficiency and communication quality. Experimental results demonstrate that, compared with benchmarks, the proposed MC-DSA improves image semantic segmentation accuracy while maintaining task execution efficiency. As a result, it reduces redundant transmissions and offers an effective solution for multi-UAV communication networks.

[MA-9] ake It From Here: Evaluating Coding Agents On Project Takeover

【速读】：该论文旨在解决生成式代码代理（Coding Agents）在接手长期项目时，如何从交互历史中恢复当前适用的需求并据此更新项目的问题。现有编码基准普遍缺乏长期交互历史支持，且评估体系未能涵盖从需求重构到项目交付的完整流程，导致对代理“接管能力”的评估不充分。为此，本文提出一种新评估范式：向代理提供完整的交互历史、当前请求及前置项目环境，要求其完成修改并以交付测试评估表现。实验表明，在包含完整历史信息的条件下，六种模型配置在37个可执行验证目标上的平均完整交付率仅为4.95%。通过引入需求原子（requirement atoms）进行独立诊断，进一步分析了代理在相关信源识别、前置状态重建和当前请求处理三个环节的表现；当提供正确前置或目标状态后，平均完整交付率提升至8.11%，构建与回归测试通过率分别达96.40%和90.99%，但目标测试成功率仍仅9.01%。这揭示出代理在形成正确的目标需求状态以及将目标需求准确实施于现有项目中仍存在显著困难。基于上述发现，本文提出ReqMemBench，一个融合需求诊断与交付验证的系统性评估框架，旨在全面衡量代码代理的项目接管能力。

Abstract:Coding agents increasingly collaborate on long-term projects. When taking over a project, they need to recover currently applicable requirements from the interaction history and update them in response to new requests. However, most coding benchmarks do not include long interaction histories, and some evaluations that consider history still do not cover the full process from requirement reconstruction to project delivery. We therefore provide agents with the interaction history, current request, and pre-request project environment, ask them to make the requested changes, and assess takeover performance through delivery tests. Across six model-harness configurations and 37 targets eligible for executable validation, the mean complete-delivery rate under Full History is only 4.95%. We then use requirement atoms to independently diagnose a larger set of takeover targets, examining relevant information identification, pre-request state reconstruction, and current request processing. We further supply correct pre-request or target states to examine the remaining difficulties in requirement processing and project modification. The diagnostics show that none of the six configurations produces fully correct post-request requirement states, and a case illustrates omission of previously recovered constraints during updating. With correct target states supplied, the mean complete-delivery rate is 8.11%, with build and regression pass rates of 96.40% and 90.99%, but target-test success remains 9.01%. These results show difficulties in both forming target requirement states and implementing supplied targets in existing projects. Based on these findings, we introduce ReqMemBench, which combines requirement diagnostics with delivery validation to support systematic evaluation of project takeover.

[MA-10] More Agents More Reliable? System-Level Reliability of Multi-Agent LLM s under Operational-Profile Uncertainty

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体系统（multi-agent systems）在实际部署中可靠性评估失真的问题，即当前普遍假设“更多智能体意味着更高可靠性”的误区。现有评估方法依赖平均基准准确率，忽视了真实输入分布的复杂性以及各智能体输出合并规则（combining rule）本身可能存在的失效风险。为应对这一挑战，作者提出一种融合分层不精确概率评估（HIP-LLM）与系统故障逻辑贝叶斯网络（Bayesian network）的框架，实现对智能体失败概率区间的传播分析。该框架揭示了合并规则自身失效对整体系统可靠性的影响，并生成一个可靠性包络（reliability envelope），用于界定不同证据下系统的可信可靠性边界。实验表明，在提取受监管化学危害声明的流水线任务中，三模型多数投票虽能抵御最弱模型的干扰，但未能显著超越最优模型；而当投票机制在5%的请求中失效时，其相对优势几乎完全丧失。研究结论指出，增加智能体数量并不自动提升系统可靠性，而是通过提供更稳健的可靠性论证（more defensible reliability claim）来增强可信度。该方案的关键在于将智能体失败概率区间与系统级故障逻辑建模相结合，从而实现对可靠性不确定性的量化与传播。

Abstract:Teams increasingly build software from cooperating large language model (LLM) agents, often assuming more agents mean more reliability. Yet the usual evidence, average benchmark accuracy, ignores the input mix a deployed system meets and the rule merging the agents’ answers. Building on HIP-LLM, a hierarchical imprecise-probability assessment of single LLMs, we propose a framework combining it with a Bayesian network of the system’s failure logic for multi-agent systems. Agent failure-probability intervals propagate through this network, where the combining rule can itself fail, into a reliability envelope showing which evidence limits it. In a pipeline extracting regulated chemical-hazard statements, majority voting over three models protected against the weakest but did not clearly exceed the best, and a voter failing on 5% of demands would largely erase its advantage over the middle model. More agents yield a more defensible reliability claim, not automatically a more reliable system.

【速读】：该论文旨在解决利润最大化型自动驾驶按需出行（AMoD）运营商通过动态溢价定价（surge pricing）攫取消费者剩余，以及将车辆从低盈利区域转移导致服务覆盖不足的问题。其核心解决方案在于引入基于惩罚机制的监管框架，通过在多模式交通系统中构建外部控制环路来约束运营商行为。关键创新在于将监管建模为两种形式：静态监管采用固定惩罚的马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），用于联合优化定价与车辆再平衡；动态监管则采用部分可观测随机博弈（Partially Observable Stochastic Game），使监管者能够根据实时状态周期性调整区域特定惩罚，实现闭环调控。通过基于图的多智能体强化学习方法联合训练运营商与监管者策略，在真实曼哈顿数据上的实验表明，固定溢价惩罚可将遭遇过高价格的乘客比例从22%降至1%；而动态监管相比同均值强度的固定惩罚，可使监管者收益提升最高达15.6%，尤其在车队冗余容量充足时服务可用性改善显著；当车队在高峰时段高度饱和时，服务缺口仍存在，此时学习到的监管策略会自动降低惩罚以适应运力限制。研究揭示了监管目标、运营商盈利与出行者效用之间的权衡关系。

Abstract:Profit-maximizing Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand (AMoD) operators may exploit consumer surplus through excessive prices and underserve less profitable regions by relocating vehicles away from them. We study how penalty-based regulation of an AMoD operator in a multimodal mobility system can limit surge pricing and improve regional service availability. We model regulation as an outer control loop that acts on a learning-based operator. Static regulation with fixed penalties is formulated as a Markov Decision Process for an operator that jointly controls pricing and rebalancing, and dynamic regulation as a Partially Observable Stochastic Game in which a regulator periodically adjusts region-specific penalties in closed loop. Operator and regulator policies are learned with graph-based multi-agent reinforcement learning. In experiments with real-world Manhattan data, fixed surge pricing penalties reduce the share of travelers facing excessive prices from 22% to 1%. For regional service availability, dynamic regulation improves the regulator’s reward by up to 15.6% over fixed penalties of equal mean intensity. The gains in service availability are strongest when spare fleet capacity exists, whereas service deficits persist in peak periods with highly utilized fleets. The learned regulator policy responds by reducing penalties where limited fleet capacity restricts compliance. The results identify trade-offs between regulatory targets, operator profitability, and traveler utility.

[MA-12] Polynomial-Time Computation of Extensive-Form Proper Equilibria in Two-Player Zero-Sum Games

【速读】：该论文旨在解决在具有完美回忆和有理数数据的有限双人零和广义形式博弈中，如何在确定性多项式时间内计算一个精确的扩展形式适当均衡（extensive-form proper equilibrium）的问题。其核心挑战在于确保均衡满足局部适当性条件：在每个信息集上，相较于更优动作，当前动作需受到惩罚，而其他局部行为选择（包括自身未来行动）保持不变。解决方案的关键在于引入几何对称多面体（permutahedron）来表征每个信息集上允许的动作概率空间，并通过缩放的双重随机表示将这些约束嵌入一个多项式规模的序列形式多面体（sequence-form polytope）中；随后，鞍点解可满足局部ε-适当性不等式。为获得精确均衡而非任意小数值扰动下的近似解，作者建立了参数线性系统的符号稳定性，构造了持久可行基，并提取了行为比例的极限值，最终得到具有多项式编码长度的有理数概率分布，即使在实现概率为零的信息集上亦成立。

Abstract:We give a deterministic polynomial-time algorithm for computing an exact extensive-form proper equilibrium in a finite two-player zero-sum extensive-form game with perfect recall and rational data. Properness is understood in the agent normal form: an action at an information set is penalized relative to a better action while all other local behavioral choices, including the player’s own future actions, remain fixed. Our algorithm assigns each information set a geometric permutahedron of allowable action probabilities. A scaled doubly stochastic representation embeds these restrictions in a polynomial-size sequence-form polytope; a saddle point then satisfies the local \varepsilon -properness inequalities. To obtain an exact equilibrium rather than a solution at an arbitrarily small numerical perturbation, we establish sign stability of a parametric linear system, construct a persistent feasible basis, and extract the limits of behavioral ratios. The resulting probabilities are rational and have polynomial encoding length, including at information sets whose realization probabilities vanish.

[MA-13] Cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning via Epigraph-Form Guided Exploration NEURIPS2026

【速读】：该论文旨在解决多智能体强化学习（MARL）中由于联合状态-动作空间的组合复杂性导致协同行为难以通过试错机制自发涌现的问题。现有方法常依赖内在奖励（intrinsic reward）促进探索，但直接将内在奖励与团队目标结合会扭曲学习信号，进而损害任务性能。为此，本文提出EFXPLORER，一种受约束的探索框架，其核心在于在保证已建立的任务性能的前提下最大化探索目标。解决方案的关键是采用等式重构（epigraph reformulation），引入自适应探索预算，实现内在奖励与任务目标的解耦，并通过任务可行性来调控探索强度。为进一步激励多样化且具有长期时序依赖性的探索行为，还设计了基于后继距离（successor distance）的内在奖励机制，以捕捉长程依赖关系。实验结果表明，该方法在SMAX、VMAS和MPE等多个基准测试中均显著优于现有强基线，成功诱导出新颖的协作策略。

Abstract:Discovering cooperative behavior in multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) is challenging due to the combinatorial complexity of joint state-action spaces, which hinders the emergence of coordinated behaviors from trial-and-error alone. Intrinsic rewards are often used to aid discovery, but naively combining them with team objectives can distort the learning signal, compromising task performance. In this paper, we propose EFXPLORER, a constrained exploration framework that maximizes exploration objectives subject to a constraint that preserves established task performance. We solve the resulting problem using an epigraph reformulation that introduces adaptive exploration budgets. This approach separates intrinsic rewards from task objectives and regulates exploration through task feasibility. To further encourage diverse and temporally extended exploration, we incorporate a successor distance-based intrinsic reward that captures long-horizon dependencies. Empirically, our method outperforms strong baselines and induces novel cooperative strategies across SMAX, VMAS, and MPE benchmark suites.

[MA-14] Authorization Propagation in Agent 2Agent Systems: An Experimental Security Evaluation of Multi-Hop Delegation

【速读】：该论文旨在解决委托代理间（Agent-to-Agent, A2A）工作流中因请求发起方与权限原始主体不一致而引发的安全问题，尤其关注授权传播过程中的信任传递与语义完整性。其核心解决方案在于采用分层的下游验证设计，通过将当前调用者上下文、传递性授权证据、每跳基于Ed25519的请求认证以及独立的重放状态分别隔离处理，实现对请求与授权凭证的细粒度控制。关键创新点在于将请求认证与继承的授权解耦，确保每个代理节点可独立验证请求合法性，同时识别出“起源可验证的委托路径”与“语义授权衰减”作为强化A2A授权传播安全性的必要条件。实验表明，在15种对抗场景中14种被成功拒绝，且在固定深度本地基准测试中，系统具备5.11毫秒的中位安全处理延迟和3.87 kB的序列化负载，验证了该方案在安全性与性能间的良好平衡。

Abstract:Delegated Agent2Agent (A2A) workflows create a security problem when the agent sending a request is different from the principal from which the authority originated. This paper evaluates a layered downstream-verification design in a synthetic four-party healthcare reimbursement workflow. The prototype separates current-caller context, transitive authorization evidence, per-hop Ed25519 request authentication, and independent replay state for requests and authorization artifacts. Of 15 adversarial conditions, 14 are rejected; an isolated delegation-path test exposes the absence of semantic authority attenuation. A separate authorized-intermediary experiment shows that a holder of the shared authorization-evidence HMAC key can modify the represented authority and generate valid evidence. In the fixed-depth local benchmark, the full configuration has a median security-processing latency of 5.11 ms and a 3.87 kB serialized payload. The results show the value of separating request authentication from inherited authority while identifying origin-verifiable delegation and semantic attenuation as requirements for stronger A2A authorization propagation.

[MA-15] he Two-Ledger Model: Transaction-Grain Cost Accounting for Multi-Agent AI Systems Across Clouds Models and Systems of Record

【速读】：该论文旨在解决企业在使用多智能体生成式AI（Generative AI）系统进行业务交易时，因计费数据粒度与业务交易边界不匹配而导致的可追溯性与成本归因难题。核心问题在于：云服务提供商仅提供以结算粒度（settlement grain）聚合的账单数据（按SKU和计费周期汇总），无法识别具体订单、索赔或案件的生成式AI实际消耗成本，导致企业难以实现精细化的财务运营（FinOps）管理。其解决方案的关键是提出“双账本模型”（Two-Ledger Model），将符合FOCUS规范的结算账本（基于聚合账单数据）与基于OpenTelemetry GenAI遥测构建的溯源账本（以调用粒度，invocation-grain，记录使用行为）相融合。该模型通过分层相关性脊柱（trace context、A2A/MCP元数据、业务键关联、概率匹配）实现调用记录与业务事务的高精度映射，并结合版本化费率卡实现实时定价，最终通过周期对账将两个账本关联至发票，未解释残差可识别“影子AI”（shadow AI）支出。仿真结果表明，即使在追踪链中断（trace propagation降至零）的情况下，该模型仍能维持超过99%的成本覆盖度，残差可精准恢复预设的未计量支出（误差低于0.24个百分点），并有效识别供应商账单错误；同时，飞行中拦截机制可在2-4%的误暂停率下，将第99百分位交易成本降低高达61%。研究进一步建议将溯源账本作为标准化的、以调用粒度为基础的FOCUS扩展配置文件，以推动行业统一的生成式AI成本与用量度量标准。

Abstract:Enterprises run business transactions through multi-agent AI systems spanning clouds, large language models (LLMs), orchestration harnesses, and systems of record. Finance receives AI cost only at settlement grain, aggregated by SKU and charge period. The business question (what did this order, claim, or case cost in AI?) cannot be answered from billing data, because providers never see enterprise transaction boundaries. The FinOps Open Cost and Usage Specification (FOCUS) gives billing data one schema across providers but remains settlement-grain even as it adds AI token and requester attribution. We formalize this grain mismatch, derive seven requirements, and propose the Two-Ledger Model: a settlement ledger of FOCUS-conformant billing data joined to an attribution ledger of invocation-grain usage records built on OpenTelemetry GenAI telemetry. A layered correlation spine (trace context, A2A/MCP metadata, business-key correlation, probabilistic matching) assigns each record to its business transaction with recorded method and confidence; a versioned rate card prices usage in near real time; period reconciliation ties both ledgers to the invoice, and the unexplained residual identifies shadow AI. Costs are reported per order, claim, or outcome with agentic cost metrics. A simulation with known ground truth shows the spine sustaining cost coverage above 99% as trace propagation falls to zero, the reconciliation residual recovering planted unmetered spend within 0.24 percentage points while flagging provider billing errors, and mid-flight gating cutting p99 transaction cost by up to 61% at a 2-4% false-pause rate. We propose the attribution ledger as an invocation-grain FOCUS profile for standardization.

[MA-16] A Bilevel Neurodynamic Approach for Distributed SCAD-Regularized Sparse Least Squares

【速读】：该论文旨在解决分布式稀疏最小二乘问题在平滑截断绝对偏差（SCAD）正则化下的全局最优求解难题。由于SCAD惩罚项具有非光滑性和非凸性，现有分布式神经动力学方法无法直接推广至该场景。其解决方案的关键在于构建一种基于双层粒子群优化（PSO）-神经动力学的协同优化框架：首先通过双时间尺度奇异摄动分析，建立了无需二阶充分条件即可保证收敛性的内层多智能体神经动力系统全轨迹收敛理论，并给出明确的收敛速率；其次，在外层引入“红绿灯”敏感性机制，指导PSO搜索过程以增强全局探索能力，同时聚焦于SCAD形状参数的优化，从而在提升稀疏恢复精度的同时显著提高计算效率。仿真结果表明，所提方法在四种稀疏恢复场景中均能准确重构真实稀疏结构，且收敛速度更快、相对误差更低。

Abstract:This paper proposes a bilevel particle swarm optimization (PSO)-neurodynamic method for solving the distributed sparse least-squares problem regularized by the smoothly clipped absolute deviation (SCAD) penalty to global optimality. The SCAD penalty is nonsmooth and nonconvex, so existing distributed neurodynamic methods have not been extended to it directly. Through two-time-scale singular perturbation analysis, a rigorous full-trajectory convergence theory with explicit convergence rates is established for the inner collaborative multi-agent neurodynamic system without requiring the second-order sufficient condition. A theory-guided inner-outer collaborative optimization framework is further developed, in which a red-light green-light sensitivity mechanism is embedded in the outer PSO search to enhance global search while concentrating computational effort on the SCAD shape parameters, thereby improving recovery accuracy and computational efficiency. Simulation results on four sparse-recovery scenarios demonstrate that the proposed method accurately recovers the true sparsity pattern and achieves faster convergence and lower relative error than competing neurodynamic methods.

[NLP-0] Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI在科学研究中缺乏可执行、可评估的实验环境这一核心问题。当前，尽管生成式AI（Generative AI）已具备一定的科研能力，但其无法直接在人类科学家积累的科学文献中“运行”——这些文献虽可读却不可执行，导致AI难以真正参与或超越人类研究。为此，本文提出构建“科学世界”（Scientist World），将每一篇研究论文转化为一个可执行的研究环境：通过自动化流程提取论文中的开放性研究问题，并复现其提出的方法作为基线；在此环境中，AI-科学家可被评估其表现与原始作者成果的对比。该工作释放了首批1000个经验证的可执行环境，实证表明前沿水平的AI-科学家已在74%的情况下超越人类研究人员。该系统不仅作为记录人工智能开展科学研究过程的档案（包含6400小时的研究轨迹，涵盖所有想法、实验、失败与成功），更成为训练新模型的有效平台——通过该环境，小型模型的研究构思能力提升了158%，达到与前沿模型相当的水平。因此，解决方案的关键在于构建一个可执行、可评估且持续演化的科学生态，使AI-科学家不仅能“学习”科学，还能在真实研究环境中“成长”并反哺科学本身。

作者: Taiming Lu,Sachin Konan,Zhuang Liu
机构: Princeton University (普林斯顿大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted - centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper’s open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. We release the first 1,000 verified environments. With the world as an evaluation, we found that frontier AI-Scientists can already surpass the human researchers 74% of the time. As a record of how AI does science, it contains 6,400 hours of research traces, with every idea, experiment, failure, and success. As a training ground, we are able to raise (+158%) a small model to match frontier models in research ideation. At last, AI-Scientists’ own world has arrived, grown from and growing with science itself.

[NLP-1] Unpacking the Compute Efficiency of Strong-to-Weak OPD against GRPO

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式 AI 模型训练中高计算成本与高效知识迁移之间的矛盾，具体聚焦于在保证目标精度的前提下，如何减少强化学习（Reinforcement Learning, RL）或基于教师-学生架构的策略蒸馏（如 on-policy distillation, OPD）所需的训练浮点运算量（FLOPs）。其核心问题是：相较于传统的强化学习方法，是否可通过优化的教师-学生蒸馏框架，在更低的计算开销下实现相当甚至更优的模型性能。解决方案的关键在于采用一种多教师蒸馏策略——多教师 OPD（Multi-teacher OPD），即利用多个领域专用的 GRPO（Group Relative Policy Optimization）专家模型作为教师，将各领域专长统一蒸馏至一个通用学生模型中。研究发现，当教师为学生自身历史训练的 GRPO 检查点时，OPD 能以高达 50 倍的效率恢复对应精度；进一步扩展至多领域场景，该方法可在仅消耗 5.2%~8.0% 的专家模型训练 FLOPs 的情况下完成知识融合，整体训练流程相较联合训练的 GRPO 减少 42.0% 的总计算量，显著提升了跨域通用模型构建的能效比。

作者: Zeyu Leo Liu,Yang Li,Bo Pang,Emre Can Acikgoz,Xuan-Phi Nguyen,Anurag Koul,Srijan Bansal,Erik Nijkamp,Shafiq Joty,Semih Yavuz
机构: Salesforce AI Research

点击查看摘要

Abstract:On-policy distillation (OPD) trains a student on its own rollouts under a frozen teacher’s per-token supervision. Does this dense signal reduce the training FLOPs needed to reach a target accuracy compared with reinforcement learning? We systematically compare vanilla reverse-KL OPD with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) across task difficulty, student and teacher size, domain, and optimization choices, measuring held-out accuracy against training FLOPs. With an external post-trained teacher, OPD generally loses to GRPO in accuracy per training FLOP at matched settings, even when the teacher is further trained with GRPO, and often suffers response-length inflation. Yet a different teacher changes the picture: when the teacher is the student’s own GRPO checkpoint, OPD recovers that checkpoint’s accuracy on math with 50\times fewer distillation FLOPs than GRPO needs to reach the same accuracy. Following the same teacher setting, we consistently observe this high efficiency with a larger student, on code, and in a second model family. On a single domain, however, the GRPO checkpoint is already the desired model, so distilling it adds to total compute. Across domains, separate GRPO checkpoints hold different capabilities, and no single checkpoint serves every domain. Multi-teacher OPD (DeepSeek-AI, 2026) consolidates per-domain GRPO experts into a single student that matches each expert’s accuracy, with the distillation stage costing only 5.2% (on 2 domains) and 8.0% (on 4 domains) of the specialist training FLOPs. Counting specialist training and distillation together, this pipeline reaches joint GRPO’s performance on the 2-domain mix with 42.0% fewer total FLOPs.

[NLP-2] Label-Wording Augmentation in a Typed-Decision Encoder: Gains on Unfamiliar Words Not on Abbreviations or Codes

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式模型在决策任务中因标签表述（label wording）不可控而导致的准确性下降问题，尤其关注多语言交叉编码器（cross-encoder）在实际应用中对标签变体敏感所带来的性能波动。其核心解决方案在于引入一种标签表面形式增强（augmentation that presents labels in several surface forms），通过在推理阶段以多种表达方式呈现标签，提升模型对不同表述的鲁棒性。实验表明，在使用普通词汇、借词（如英语术语）、职场俚语及部门名称等非标准标签时，经过增强的版本在所有设置下均表现出更高准确率，最大提升达0.24，其中11项提升在统计校正后仍显著；尤其在术语类标签上，标签层级的置信区间不包含零，证明其有效性。然而，在缩写和模糊代码场景下，增强版本未带来可用性能增益，甚至在部分情况下表现更差。此外，研究还揭示了对比两个版本时存在的四项评估陷阱，提示需谨慎解读模型改进效果。

Abstract:Typed-decision models score options that the caller supplies at request time, so their accuracy depends on label wording that the model’s developer does not control. We compare two releases of a 307M-parameter multilingual cross-encoder, Ru-Jev, trained on thirteen Russian-language tasks; the later release adds an augmentation that presents labels in several surface forms. Holding questions fixed and varying only how eighteen routing labels are worded, we evaluate ten label vocabularies, produced by three separate processes and checked for overlap with the training data, with five candidates per question and, for eight of them, also with eighteen. On held-out vocabularies made of ordinary or borrowed words (English-derived jargon, office slang, department names), the augmented release is more accurate in every setting, by up to 0.24. Eleven of these fourteen gains survive a Holm correction (slang with eighteen candidates and descriptive sentences with five do not), and for jargon on all labels the label-level interval excludes zero in both settings. On abbreviations and opaque codes it gives no usable gain: on abbreviations it is not better, and worse on the clean slice, and on opaque codes both releases stay at or below chance once labels related to training options are removed. In most cells where accuracy rises, the risk-coverage area falls, but with eighteen candidates confident errors rise on jargon and slang. On two datasets neither release saw, accuracy moves by -8.4 and +5.6 points. We also report four evaluation hazards from comparing the two releases.

[NLP-3] Understanding AI from the Inside: The State of Mechanistic Interpretability for AI Safety

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前生成式人工智能（Generative AI）系统日益增强的自主性与不可控性所带来的安全风险问题，核心挑战在于：尽管模型能力不断提升，但其内部工作机制仍缺乏透明性，导致难以预测其在未知场景下的行为或实现可靠控制。论文提出的关键解决方案是通过机制可解释性（mechanistic interpretability），从模型内部的表征结构与计算过程入手，揭示其决策逻辑的本质。其关键在于构建可验证的内部因果机制（如神经元特征、计算电路等），以实现对模型行为的预测、干预与监控。研究系统梳理了机制可解释性的理论基础（如特征解耦、多义性、Transformer计算机制与电路发现）、方法体系（包括特征提取、因果验证、自然语言解释、训练动态分析等），并提出一个统一的评估框架来衡量可解释性主张的有效性。同时，论文探讨了机制理解在知识编辑、行为引导和持续监控等安全应用中的潜力，也指出了其局限性与尚未解决的开放问题，强调机制可解释性应与行为层面的安全评估相辅相成，共同推动安全可控的人工智能发展。

Li,Aaron Maiwald,Narmeen Fatimah Oozeer,Naomi Saphra,Or David Shafran,Adi Simhi,Robert Trager,Shriyash Kaustubh Upadhyay,Ziyu Yao,Yu Zhao,Shay B. Cohen,Mor Geva,Yoshua Bengio,Stella Biderman,Hassan Sajjad

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Neural networks are likely to be among the most consequential artefacts in human history. As these systems become more capable and autonomous, their potential to cause societal harm also grows, making AI safety one of the defining challenges of our time. Yet we continue to build increasingly powerful systems without fully understanding how they work, how they will behave in unfamiliar situations, or how to reliably control them. Mechanistic interpretability offers a path towards understanding these systems by studying their internal representations and computations, with the aim of evaluating, predicting, and controlling behaviour. We survey mechanistic interpretability for AI safety in order to answer the question: Does understanding how models work actually make them safer? We place mechanistic interpretability in the broader context of interpretability research and compare its mechanistic evidence with behavioural evaluation. We introduce the foundations of mechanistic interpretability, including features, polysemanticity, transformer computation, and circuits, and survey methods for feature extraction and analysis, circuit discovery and causal verification, explaining intermediate representations in natural language, learning dynamics, and training-data attribution. Beyond surveying existing methods, we propose a unified framework for evaluating mechanistic interpretability claims and characterise six research orientations by their goals, assumptions, and trade-offs. Finally, we examine how mechanistic understanding can support AI safety, including knowledge editing, steering, and monitoring, and assess its limitations, failure modes, open problems, and relationship to behavioural safety measures. We also release a repository of code notebooks with worked examples that reproduce key findings from surveyed methods, allowing readers to build intuition through hands-on experimentation.

[NLP-4] MedGraph: Maintaining Patient State with Graph Memory for Long-Term Medical Dialogue

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决基于大语言模型（LLM）的医疗助手在跨就诊场景中维持患者临床状态记忆准确性的关键问题。现有记忆系统在纵向医疗对话中存在三类反复出现的错误：检索到的证据反映过时状态、混入了他人健康信息，或缺失回答所依赖的安全性事实。为应对这些问题，论文提出MedGraph——一种专为此三类问题设计的图结构记忆系统。其核心解决方案在于：通过从每轮会话中提取带时间戳的事实，将每个事实归属至对应患者，并将药物、诊断与测量记录构建为保持历史状态的时间链；在检索阶段，以患者的时间链为单位进行排序，按问题所涉时间点读取相应链段，并结合原始对话文本进行上下文增强；同时构建患者档案，统一列出所有已记录的安全性事实以供问答参考。实验表明，在MedMemoryBench基准测试中，无论采用GPT还是Qwen作为主干模型，MedGraph均显著优于五种基线方法，分别提升10.5和10.4分，且在内存构建与推理效率方面表现优异。

Abstract:LLM-based medical assistants that follow a patient across visits need a memory that keeps the patient’s clinical state correct as it changes. We examine the errors of five memory systems on longitudinal medical dialogue and find three recurring causes: the retrieved evidence gives an outdated state, includes another person’s health facts, or lacks a safety fact the answer depends on. We present MedGraph, a graph memory built for these three cases. Construction extracts dated facts from each session, attributes each fact to the person it describes, and links medication, diagnosis, and measurement records into chains that keep earlier states. Retrieval ranks the patient’s chains as units, reads each chain at the time the question asks about, and adds the original dialogue text; a patient profile lists every recorded safety fact with every question. On MedMemoryBench, MedGraph has the highest overall accuracy with both a GPT and a Qwen backbone, 10.5 and 10.4 points above the strongest of five baselines, with efficient memory construction and answering in the GPT setting.

[NLP-5] StepBack: Step-Level Error-Localized Resampling for Efficient Test-Time Reasoning NEURIPS2026

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决自洽性（Self-consistency, SC）推理策略在测试时推理过程中计算开销大、资源消耗高的问题，尤其是其需要大量完整推理轨迹采样的缺陷。现有高效变体虽通过提前终止采样或分散采样数量来降低代价，但仍难以在保持高准确率的同时显著减少计算成本。本文提出一种名为StepBack的步骤级错误定位重采样方法，其核心在于：基于少量初始草稿推理轨迹，利用轻量级信号精准定位最可能产生首次错误的推理步骤，并仅对出错步骤及其后续部分进行重采样，最后通过多数投票确定最终答案。该方法在七项数学推理与多跳问答基准上平均性能与SC相当，同时可将令牌使用量最多降低41.26%。此外，由于其设计特性，StepBack可与自适应推理方法（如Adaptive Consistency）无缝结合，进一步提升推理效率。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08403
作者: Yang Ouyang,Jung-Eun Kim
机构: North Carolina State University (北卡罗来纳州立大学)
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注: NeurIPS 2026

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Self-consistency (SC) is a widely used decoding strategy for improving chain-of-thought reasoning, but it requires sampling many complete reasoning trajectories with a preset budget. Its efficient variants reduce the cost mainly by stopping full-trajectory sampling early or distributing the number of samples across questions. In this paper, we propose StepBack, a step-level error-localized resampling method for efficient test-time reasoning. Given a small set of draft trajectories, StepBack localizes likely first error positions using lightweight signals and then resamples the detected error step and its suffix, followed by majority answer voting. Empirically, StepBack matches the accuracy of SC on average across seven mathematical reasoning and multi-hop QA benchmarks, while reducing token usage by up to 41.26%. In addition, by nature, StepBack can be combined with adaptive inference methods such as Adaptive Consistency, further improving their inference-time efficiency.

[NLP-6] SpecCTMC: Exact Speculative Simulation of Diffusion Language Model Continuous-Time Markov Chains

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式AI（Generative AI）中基于掩码扩散语言模型（Masked Diffusion Language Models）进行并行文本生成时，因独立采样多个词元（token）而破坏其依赖关系、改变输出分布的问题。现有精确的连续时间采样方法虽可避免近似误差，但通常需对每个词元进行一次串行模型评估，形成计算瓶颈。为克服这一问题，论文提出一种无需训练的推测采样方法SpecCTMC，其核心在于利用先前已计算的模型预测结果，通过一系列连续的词元更新策略，在并行评估中间状态的基础上，结合精确的接受-修正（acceptance-and-correction）机制完成采样。该方法保证了底层连续时间马尔可夫链（Continuous-Time Markov Chain, CTMC）中事件发生时间、生成顺序与词元取值的联合分布不变，从而既无时间离散化误差，也无并行解码引入的额外因子分解误差。在LLaDA-8B-Instruct和Dream-v0-Instruct-7B across five benchmarks上的实验表明，SpecCTMC相比直接连续时间采样减少了1.73–4.38倍的串行模型评估次数，同时保持了参考采样分布的准确性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08362
作者: Siva Rajesh Kasa,Yasong Dai,Sumit Negi,Hongdong Li
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注: 28 pages, 5 figures

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Masked diffusion language models offer parallel text generation, but independently sampling multiple tokens can disrupt their dependencies and change the output distribution. Exact continuous-time sampling avoids this approximation, yet typically requires one sequential model evaluation per token. We introduce SpecCTMC, a training-free speculative sampler that reduces this sequential bottleneck without a separate draft model. SpecCTMC proposes successive token updates using previously computed model predictions, evaluates their intermediate states in parallel, and applies an exact acceptance-and-correction procedure. We prove that SpecCTMC preserves the joint distribution of event times, generation order, and token values of the underlying continuous-time Markov chain. It therefore introduces neither time-discretization error nor additional factorization error from parallel decoding. Experiments on LLaDA-8B-Instruct and Dream-v0-Instruct-7B across five benchmarks demonstrate 1.73-4.38x fewer sequential model evaluations than direct continuous-time sampling, while preserving the reference sampling distribution. Our code is available at: this https URL

[NLP-7] Cultural Adaptation within Repeated Social Interactions

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（LLM）在跨文化情境中缺乏动态适应能力的问题，尤其针对人类文化知识具有隐性特征且主要通过情境化社会互动习得这一现实。传统评估方法仅关注模型“知道什么”，而忽视其在持续交互中学习和调整行为的能力。为此，研究提出将文化适应（cultural adaptation）重新定义为通过社会互动实现规范内化（norm assimilation）的连续过程，并设计了一个沙盒环境以模拟重复交互场景。其解决方案的关键在于引入记忆机制（memory mechanisms），使模型能够在多次交互中积累经验、实现纵向学习（longitudinal learning），并具备跨不同社交场景的迁移能力，以及在五种语言间实现多语言规范内化的潜力。该方法为构建持续、交互驱动的文化适应性大语言模型奠定了基础。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08334
作者: Chen Cecilia Liu,Roi Reichart,Anna Korhonen
机构: Language Technology Lab - University of Cambridge(剑桥大学语言技术实验室); Technion - Israel Institute of Technology(以色列理工学院)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Much of human culture is tacit and is typically learned through situated social interaction. As LLMs are deployed as interactive agents across diverse communities, assessing their cultural competence demands moving beyond existing question-answering approaches, shifting from what they know to how they adapt. In this work, we broaden the scope of cultural adaptation in NLP by investigating whether LLMs can adapt through repeated interactions via a sandbox environment. By reframing cultural adaptation as a continuous process of norm assimilation through social interaction, our work demonstrates that memory mechanisms foster longitudinal learning across repeated interactions, facilitate transfer to different social settings, and enable multilingual norm assimilation across five languages. Together, our findings lay the groundwork for continuous, interaction-driven cultural adaptation in LLMs.

[NLP-8] Polarity Classification with Multitask Learning Syntax Augmentation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决情感分析（Sentiment Analysis, SA）中因否定、强化等语言现象导致的主观信息识别困难问题，同时克服传统语法解析方法带来的高计算开销。其核心挑战在于如何高效融合句法知识以提升模型对复杂语义结构的建模能力，而不依赖于推理阶段的外部解析器或人工设计的组合规则。解决方案的关键在于提出两种基于统一多任务学习（Multi-Task Learning, MTL）的句法知识集成策略：一是标准多任务学习（Standard-MTL），通过共享编码器并行学习序列标注形式的依存句法解析与情感极性分类；二是对比式多任务学习（Contrastive-MTL），采用对比辅助目标和语法偏置注意力池化机制，在不进行显式标签预测的前提下实现隐式句法引导。实验结果表明，Contrastive-MTL在11个跨语言数据集上优于基线模型，且在6个可比数据集上超越需推理时解析的规则系统（SELSP），同时推理速度提升1.5至9倍，验证了训练阶段隐式句法监督可有效替代推理阶段显式解析，显著降低计算开销而保持甚至提升性能。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08323
作者: Muhammad Imran,Carlos Gómez-Rodríguez
机构: Universidade da Coruña, CITIC (拉科鲁尼亚大学，信息与计算机科学系); Universidade da Coruña, CITIC (拉科鲁尼亚大学，信息与计算机科学系)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Sentiment Analysis (SA) is a fundamental NLP task concerned with the identification and categorization of subjective information in text. While lexicon-based methods offer transparency, they often struggle with linguistic phenomena such as negation and intensification. Syntactic parsing has been integrated into SA pipelines to address this, but conventional parsers introduce significant computational overhead. Recent work shows that reformulating dependency parsing as a Sequence Labeling (SEL) task can improve efficiency. We propose and compare two strategies for integrating syntactic knowledge into a neural sentiment analysis model under unified Multi-Task Learning (MTL). The first, Standard-MTL, jointly learns dependency parsing (via sequence labeling) and sentiment polarity classification using a shared encoder with two task-specific heads. The second, Contrastive-MTL, provides implicit syntactic guidance through a contrastive auxiliary objective and a syntax-biased attention pooling mechanism, without requiring explicit label prediction. Both rely on syntactic annotations during training and eliminate need for hand-crafted compositional rules or external parsing at inference. We evaluate eleven datasets spanning seven languages—the MARC corpus (English, Spanish, French, German) and seven datasets from SemEval-2022 Task 10 (English, Spanish, Norwegian, Basque, Catalan)—using four established SEL encodings. With the relative encoding, Contrastive-MTL outperforms a syntax-naive baseline on 10 of 11 datasets and surpasses the external rule-based pipeline (SELSP) that parses at inference on all six datasets where the latter applies, while being 1.5–9 \times faster at evaluation. Standard-MTL is more dataset- and encoding-dependent. These results show implicit syntactic supervision during training can match or exceed explicit parsing at inference without computational overhead.

[NLP-9] Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在生物医学与认知神经科学领域中，面对异构知识图谱（Heterogeneous Knowledge Graphs, KGs）时推理能力不可靠的问题。核心挑战在于如何有效融合通用语言理解能力与结构化领域知识，以提升复杂推理任务中的准确性与可解释性。其解决方案的关键在于引入多层级查询数据集，系统评估不同模型在具备知识图谱感知（KG-aware，即图谱引导）与无图谱感知（KG-agnostic）条件下的推理深度与事实准确性。研究发现，尽管领域专用模型在特定任务上表现有限，但通用模型（如GPT-5.1和Gemini 2.0 Pro）在多跳推理和高层级推理中表现更优，且知识图谱的引入显著降低了幻觉发生率。这一结果表明，将广泛的语言建模能力与结构化领域知识相结合是提升性能的关键路径。研究进一步提出基于任务复杂度与计算资源约束的模型-知识图谱集成策略，并探讨了混合神经符号架构在个性化医疗、认知障碍诊断及可解释人工智能中的应用前景。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08315
作者: Ali Sarabadani,Kheirolah Rahsepar Fard,Tahereh Jeirani
机构: 未知
类目: Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Computation and Language (cs.CL); Machine Learning (cs.LG)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen’s kappa of 0.781 (range: 0.753-0.807) and Fleiss’ kappa of 0.77. Results show that general-purpose models, particularly GPT-5.1 and Gemini 2.0 Pro, generally outperform domain-specific models on multi-hop and high-level reasoning tasks, although performance declines as query complexity increases. KG grounding reduces hallucination rates across all evaluated models. Contrary to our initial hypothesis, domain-specific models do not consistently outperform general-purpose models on specialized tasks without graph grounding. These findings highlight the value of combining broad language-model capabilities with structured domain knowledge. We provide practical guidance for selecting LLM-KG integration strategies based on task complexity and computational constraints, and discuss hybrid neurosymbolic architectures for personalized medicine, cognitive disorder diagnosis, and explainable AI.

[NLP-10] LLM -Assisted Label Noise Correction for EEG-Based Sleep Stage Classification

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决睡眠分期自动分类中因人工标注标签质量低下所导致的深度学习模型性能受限问题，尤其关注标注者间一致性差及系统性标注错误对模型训练的影响。其解决方案的关键在于提出一种仅在训练阶段运行的大型语言模型（LLM）辅助标签噪声过滤流程：首先利用原始数据训练TinySleepNet模型并提取每 epoch 的 SoftMax 置信度分数，将低置信度段落连同其脑电图（EEG）谱特征与邻近序列上下文一并输入 LLaMA 3.1 模型；随后，该大语言模型依据美国睡眠医学学会（AASM）睡眠分期指南对每个时间段进行评估，并判定为“可靠”或“可疑”；最终剔除被标记为“可疑”的样本后，使用清洗后的数据重新训练模型。实验结果表明，该方法在 Sleep-EDF Expanded 数据集上通过 20 折交叉验证，将整体准确率从 81.8% 提升至 84.6%，宏平均 F1 分数从 75.6% 提升至 77.4%，尤其是在快速眼动（REM）睡眠检测方面表现显著改善。由于该流程仅在训练阶段引入大语言模型，推理时仍保持 TinySleepNet 轻量级架构（仅 1.3M 参数），因此具备部署于可穿戴设备实现实时睡眠监测的可行性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08311
作者: Elmira Salari,Shruti Kshirsagar
机构: Wichita State University (威奇托州立大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Automatic sleep stage classification from electroencephalography (EEG) signals is a critical task in clinical sleep medicine. While deep learning models have shown promising results in this domain, their performance is fundamentally constrained by the quality of training labels, which human experts manually annotate and that are subject to inter-rater disagreement and systematic labeling errors. In this paper, we propose a novel LLM-assisted label-noise filtering pipeline that operates exclusively during training to identify and remove unreliable sleep-stage annotations before retraining the classifier. Specifically, TinySleepNet is first trained on the original dataset to extract per-epoch SoftMax confidence scores, then low-confidence epochs are submitted to LLaMA 3.1 along with their EEG spectral features and surrounding sequence context. The LLM evaluates each epoch against AASM sleep-scoring guidelines and assigns a verdict of RELIABLE or SUSPICIOUS. Suspicious epochs are removed from the training set, and TinySleepNet is retrained on the cleaned data. Evaluated on the Sleep-EDF Expanded dataset using 20-fold cross-validation, our method improves overall accuracy from 81.8% to 84.6% and Macro F1-score from 75.6% to 77.4%, with particularly notable gains in REM detection. Crucially, because the LLM operates only during training, the lightweight TinySleepNet architecture (1.3M parameters) is preserved at inference, making the proposed pipeline suitable for real-time, wearable sleep monitoring applications.

[NLP-11] Measured Coupling for Parallel Decoding in Diffusion Language Models

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决扩散语言模型（diffusion language models）在生成过程中每步需决定哪些词元（tokens）可安全组合的问题，传统方法如均场解码（mean-field decoding）通过惩罚预测相似的位置对来实现，但该策略仅作为近似代理，缺乏对实际依赖关系的精确刻画。其解决方案的关键在于用真实的耦合度量（coupling）替代原有的启发式惩罚机制：即通过在主前向传播中引入低成本探测器，直接测量一个词元的确定性选择如何影响模型在另一位置的置信度，从而捕捉真实上下文依赖。该方法无需额外训练或模型结构修改，可无缝嵌入原有均场规则。实验表明，在三个模型和四个基准上，该方法显著减少解码步数，多数情况下更高效，即使在启用键值缓存（key-value cache）时仍具优势，平均准确率损失仅为1.1个百分点；而随机打乱耦合或以均匀奖励替代则会丧失此性能提升，验证了耦合度量的有效性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08307
作者: Tal Oved,Lior Wolf
机构: Tel Aviv University (特拉维夫大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI); Distributed, Parallel, and Cluster Computing (cs.DC); Machine Learning (cs.LG); Performance (cs.PF)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Diffusion language models can write many tokens per step, but must choose which tokens are safe to commit together. Mean-field decoding penalizes pairs of positions whose predictions look alike. We replace this proxy with the coupling itself: how much committing one token changes the model’s confidence at another. Cheap probes inside the main forward pass measure it, with no training or extra model, and it plugs into the same mean-field rule. On three models and four benchmarks, our method needs far fewer steps than mean-field decoding and is faster in most settings, also with a key-value cache, at an average accuracy cost of 1.1 points. Shuffling the couplings or replacing them with a uniform bonus loses this gain.

[NLP-12] Multimodal-SEA: Benchmarking AI Agent Security under Multimodal Social Engineering Attacks

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决个人智能代理（Personal AI Agents）在面对由伪造多模态内容支持的社会工程攻击时，其内在安全性缺乏充分评估的问题。现有评估体系主要聚焦于文本对话场景，未能有效覆盖多模态环境下真实世界欺诈案例的复杂性。为此，研究提出Multimodal-SEA这一交互式基准，包含608个由专家设计的任务，基于真实诈骗案例构建，涵盖14个领域与152种攻击情景，并整合了预设的多模态内容。任务覆盖四个难度层级，反映中英文社会文化背景的差异。代理需在模拟应用环境中对内容进行检查、请求验证并执行操作，攻击结果基于可验证的工具执行日志生成。为实现对个人代理的可控红队测试，研究设计了一套多模态攻击框架（multimodal attack harness），集成任务信息管理、攻击进程控制及多模态内容构造功能，以评估代理在模拟环境中的抗适应性社会工程攻击能力。在六维维度上对七种主流多模态模型的评估表明，所有模型均存在显著脆弱性，攻击成功率介于7.1%至34.5%之间；引入多模态内容后，攻击成功率从19.9%上升至29.2%，即便代理主动验证覆盖率提升。强化安全指令虽能降低攻击成功率，但未提升对欺骗性多模态内容的识别能力，部分模型虽表现较低攻击成功率，却伴随过度拒绝合法请求的现象。因此，解决方案的关键在于构建一个真实、可控且多模态驱动的评估体系，揭示当前多模态代理在对抗社会工程攻击时的系统性缺陷。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08281
作者: Zhitao He,Chi Him Zhang,Chengru Han,Yi R Fung
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (香港科技大学); MMSense Lab (多媒体感知实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)
备注:

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Personal AI agents face social engineering attacks supported by forged multimodal content, but existing evaluations mainly focus on text-based dialogue, leaving their intrinsic security under such attacks insufficiently studied. We introduce Multimodal-SEA, an interactive benchmark comprising 608 expert-designed tasks grounded in real-world fraud cases, covering 14 domains and 152 attack scenarios with prepared multimodal content. The tasks span four difficulty levels and reflect the distinct social and cultural contexts of Chinese and English environments. Agents inspect content, verify requests, and execute actions in simulated applications, with attack outcomes grounded in verifiable tool execution logs. To enable controlled red teaming of personal agents, we design a multimodal attack harness that integrates task information, attack progression control, and multimodal content construction to evaluate their intrinsic security against adaptive social engineering attacks in simulated environments. Evaluating seven widely used multimodal models across six dimensions reveals that all are vulnerable, with attack success rates of 7.1% to 34.5%. Adding multimodal content increases attack success from 19.9% to 29.2%, despite increased proactive verification coverage. Stronger safety instructions reduce attack success without improving recognition of deceptive multimodal content, while lower attack success rates for some models accompany excessive refusal of legitimate requests.

[NLP-13] he Geometry of Simulated Perspectives: Dissociating Representation and Behaviour in a Multimodal Language Model

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决生成式视觉语言模型在不同角色（persona）设定下，其内部表征结构如何被重构，以及这种重构是否直接影响模型的判断行为。核心问题是：角色设定与提示语框架如何分别影响模型的内在表征几何（representational geometry）与外在行为输出之间的关系。解决方案的关键在于通过系统性实验，操控100张图像在53种不同的角色内容与语言框架下的提示条件，同时记录行为评分与各层隐藏状态，从而揭示表征动态演化规律。研究发现，早期层主要编码图像身份信息，而后期层则逐渐涌现出与角色相关的表征结构；更重要的是，提示语框架对内部表征的影响显著强于角色身份本身，但角色内容却更显著地驱动行为判断，形成“表征-行为”解耦现象。这一发现表明，内部表征距离并不必然反映行为相关性，揭示了人工认知系统中模拟视角以独特结构形式嵌入表征空间的本质机制，凸显了表征几何与其功能后果之间的根本差异。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08262
作者: Mathis Immertreu,Fitim Abdullahu,Thomas Kinfe,Claus Metzner,Helmut Grabner,Patrick Krauss,Achim Schilling
机构: University Erlangen-Nürnberg (埃尔兰根-纽伦堡大学); University Hospital Mannheim, Heidelberg University (海德堡大学曼海姆医院); BGU Ludwigshafen (路德维希港BGU); IDS Institut für Data Science, ZHAW School of Engineering (苏黎世应用科技大学工程学院数据科学研究所)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Multimodal language models can simulate different observers, yet it remains unclear how assigned perspectives reshape their internal representations and whether these changes govern their judgements. Here, we investigate the representational geometry of persona-conditioned visual interestingness in Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct. Across 100 images and 53 prompting conditions, we systematically vary persona content and the linguistic framing used to introduce it, while recording behavioural ratings and layer-wise hidden states. We observe a systematic reorganisation of representational geometry across processing depth: early layers primarily encode image identity, whereas persona-specific structures emerge in later layers. Strikingly, prompt framing reshapes internal representations more strongly than persona identity, whereas persona content has a greater impact on behavioural judgements. This dissociation is further illustrated by minimal identity statements that alter representations even without changing responses. These findings demonstrate that representational distance does not necessarily reflect behavioural relevance. More broadly, they reveal how simulated perspectives emerge as distinct structures within the representational space of artificial cognitive systems, highlighting a fundamental distinction between the geometry of internal representations and their functional consequences.

[NLP-14] rminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench: The First Agent ic and Verifiable Benchmark for Mathematical Modeling

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决现有数学建模基准测试在评估生成式模型求解能力时存在的核心缺陷：即缺乏对完整建模过程的可验证性与真实性检验。传统基准多仅评分求解片段或依赖大语言模型（LLM）进行报告打分，导致评价结果不可靠且无法复现。为此，本文提出TB-MathModel（终端式数学建模基准），作为首个将竞赛风格建模问题实现全链路智能体化、可验证性与终端交互一体化的基准平台，覆盖2023至2025年共18道中国大学生数学建模竞赛（CUMCM）与美国大学生数学建模竞赛（MCM）的真实题目。其关键创新在于两个设计：一是采用方向感知的一侧评分机制，不惩罚超越基准解的表现，避免抑制创造性；二是双层可行性验证机制——第一层为程序化检查，涵盖六种可判定的不变量形式；第二层为硬性约束，通过624个Lean 4形式化证明义务确保解的物理合理性，无效解直接被置零。此外，每项任务基于一组人类优秀论文构成参考集进行多参考评估，要求模型输出接近多个权威解，而非单一基准。实验表明，在七组多模态模型（每组三个种子）中，最强模型达到64.58%的多参考O-Eval得分，而仅需1/100成本的开源模型亦达59.81%。TB-MathModel将建模问题的数值核心转化为可复现、机器可验证的信号，不仅可用于衡量长周期建模能力，还可用于收集智能体决策轨迹，推动数学建模领域向更严谨、可审计的方向发展。

机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)(香港科技大学(广州)); IDEA Research(IDEA 研究院); DataArcTech Ltd.(数据弧科技有限公司)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Mathematical modeling turns an open-ended real-world problem into assumptions, a model, a solution, and a defended recommendation, and its answers matter only if they are both close to a credible reference and physically feasible; existing benchmarks either score solver fragments or grade reports with an LLM judge, leaving those numbers unchecked. We introduce TB-MathModel (the Terminal-style Mathematical Modeling Bench), the first benchmark to make complete contest-style modeling problems agentic, verifiable, and terminal at once, over 18 real CUMCM and MCM problems (2023–2025). Each task ships the verbatim statement, official attachments, and figures in a containerized terminal; the agent returns one JSON artifact, scored on the numeric core of the final question against a reproduction of the Outstanding-award paper. Two design choices distinguish it: direction-aware, one-sided scoring, which never penalises beating the anchor, and two-layer feasibility verification—a programmatic gate over six decidable invariant forms plus 624 Lean~4 obligations—with a hard gate that zeroes infeasible answers. Each task is scored against a panel of human outstanding papers rather than one, so a model must be close to many accepted answers; across seven multimodal entries (three seeds each) the strongest reach a multi-reference O-Eval of 64.58%, while the \ 2.54 open model holds 59.81% at 1/100 the cost. TB-MathModel turns the numeric core of modeling into a reproducible, machine-checkable signal for measuring long-horizon modeling competence and for collecting agent trajectories. The source code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-15] From Twisted Facts to Rogue Agents : Can LLM s Reliably Detect Multi-Dimensional Hallucinations?

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决大语言模型（Large Language Models, LLMs）在信息检索、内容生成及基于代理的任务执行中，其输出易受细微且高风险幻觉（hallucination）影响的问题。现有方法对幻觉的检测与纠正能力有限，尤其在细粒度定位与修正方面表现不佳，且在代理轨迹中的忠实性（faithfulness）幻觉检测上缺乏系统评估手段。为此，论文提出HaluaCheck——一个大规模、双语基准测试集，涵盖超过4.2万条样本，覆盖文本中的事实性幻觉与代理轨迹中的忠实性幻觉，并提供细粒度、多层次的标注（包括检测、定位与修正），适用于不同任务类型与扰动程度。实验结果表明，尽管主流LLMs具备基础的样本级幻觉识别能力，但在细粒度定位、修正以及代理场景下的幻觉检测方面仍存在显著不足。进一步分析显示，思维链推理（thinking）、网络搜索与监督微调虽能带来部分改善，但均未能根本性解决该问题。因此，HaluaCheck为评估和诊断大语言模型在文本与代理场景下的可靠性提供了坚实基准。

作者: Hanyu Qiu,Ze Liu,Zhe Zhao,Kuang Xiong,Blaze Chen,Zhenxiang Yan,Renfen Hu
机构: Beijing Normal University(北京师范大学); Tencent AI Lab(腾讯人工智能实验室)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models (LLMs) are widely used for information access, content production, and agent-based task execution, but their outputs remain vulnerable to subtle, high-risk hallucinations. To systematically evaluate and advance post-generation hallucination detection, we introduce HaluCheck, a large-scale, bilingual benchmark comprising over 42k instances spanning both factual hallucinations in text and faithfulness hallucinations in agent trajectories. HaluCheck features fine-grained, multi-level annotations for detection, localization, and correction, covering different tasks and perturbation degrees. Experiments on fourteen LLMs reveal that, while models show basic sample-level detection ability, they struggle with fine-grained localization, correction, and agent hallucination detection. Further analysis demonstrates that thinking, web search, and supervised fine-tuning each offer partial improvements, but none fully solve the problem. HaluCheck thus provides a solid basis for benchmarking and diagnosing LLM reliability across text and agent scenarios.

[NLP-16] Agent -R2: Scaling Agents for Realistic Productivity Work via Real-Source Data Synthesis

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决当前智能体在完成真实生产力任务时面临的瓶颈问题，即难以有效执行长周期专业工作流、理解异构文件上下文，并在细粒度要求下生成可用交付成果。其核心挑战在于缺乏能够真实反映工作意图、具备真实文件环境和可衡量交付质量的可扩展后训练数据。为此，论文提出Agent-R²——一个基于真实来源的数据合成框架，通过引入真实职业场景种子（occupational seeds）、从语料库中提取的工作流证据以及网络获取的真实文件，实现了全流程的现实性锚定。该框架从10,000个候选样本中提炼出4,000个任务实例，每个实例均包含多格式真实附件与细粒度交付标准。基于此数据，采用监督微调与基于评分规则的强化学习训练得到Agent-R²-4B模型，在仅使用4,000个实例的情况下，显著优于Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507，在GDPval（51.0% vs. 48.0%）和OfficeQA（14.8% vs. 13.8%）上取得更优表现。进一步分析表明，Agent-R²能有效缓解智能体的“捷径行为”（shortcut behavior），即在未充分接地、构建或验证前生成表面合理但实质错误的交付物，同时促进持续探索，提升推理深度与任务完成可靠性。

作者: Teng Pan,Zixuan Wang,Yuchen Yan,Qifei Wu,Yao Chen,Yingqi Qu,Ruiqing Zhang,Yongliang Shen
机构: 未知
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL)

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Large language models have made rapid progress in agentic reasoning and tool use, raising expectations for agents that can take over realistic productivity work from humans. However, current agents still struggle to finish such tasks, where success requires following long-horizon professional workflows, understanding heterogeneous file contexts, and producing usable deliverables under fine-grained requirements. A key bottleneck is the lack of scalable post-training data that reflects real work intent, authentic file environments, and deliverable-level evaluation. To close this gap, we introduce Agent-R ^2 , a \textbfr eal-source data synthesis framework that scales training data for \textbfr ealistic productivity work. Instead of relying on manually specified workflows or LLM-generated files, Agent-R ^2 grounds synthesis throughout the pipeline in real occupational seeds, corpus-derived workflow evidence, and authentic web-sourced files. From 10k web-corpus candidates, Agent-R ^2 distills 4k task instances that pair real multi-format attachments with fine-grained, deliverable-level rubrics. On this data, we train Agent-R ^2 -4B via supervised fine-tuning and rubric-based reinforcement learning, improving both end-to-end productivity performance and file-grounded reasoning. Trained on only 4k instances, Agent-R ^2 -4B surpasses Qwen3-235B-A22B-Thinking-2507 on both GDPval (51.0 % vs. 48.0 % ) and OfficeQA (14.8 % vs. 13.8 % ). Further analysis shows that Agent-R ^2 mitigates shortcut behavior, where agents produce superficially plausible deliverables before sufficiently grounding, constructing, or verifying them, while promoting sustained exploration.

[NLP-17] ProQuant: Progressive Quantization-aware Training for Edge MLLM s

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在资源受限的边缘设备上部署时面临的计算与内存开销过大的问题，尤其针对低比特量化（如权重量化至4比特，W4A8）下性能显著下降的挑战。现有后训练量化（PTQ）方法在中等比特位宽（如W8A8）下表现良好，但在低比特场景下难以维持模型性能，尤其是对适合边缘部署的小规模模型。为此，本文提出一种面向低比特多模态大模型的量化感知训练（QAT）框架——ProQuant。其关键创新在于：首先，设计自重标记（SRL）策略，通过重采样开源多模态数据集的响应，使微调数据分布更贴近预训练数据分布，缓解分布偏移问题；其次，首次从解耦视角分离多模态理解与语言建模能力，提出渐进式块激活（PBA）机制，优先恢复多模态理解能力，并引入视觉敏感因子τ⃗\vec\tauτ以精准识别对多模态感知至关重要的网络层。实验结果表明，ProQuant在多个基准测试中显著优于现有方法，例如在W4A8量化下，Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct模型平均准确率提升6.6%，且仅损失约1%的全精度性能，展现出卓越的低比特压缩效率与实用性。

链接: https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.08216
作者: Yufei Xue,Yushi Huang,Jiawei Shao,Pingcheng Dong,Yonghao Tan,Shiyao Li,Kwang-Ting Cheng,Jun Zhang
机构: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology(香港科技大学); Northwestern Polytechnical University(西北工业大学); Institute of Artificial Intelligence (TeleAI), China Telecom(中国电信人工智能研究院); Tsinghua University(清华大学)
类目: Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (cs.CV); Computation and Language (cs.CL)

Abstract:Multi-modal large language models (MLLMs) with impressive perception and understanding capabilities will enable a range of downstream applications. However, their substantial computational and memory requirements hinder the real-world implementation, particularly for resource-constrained edge devices. Quantization has emerged as an effective solution for deploying large models. While post-training quantization (PTQ) successfully retains the performance at moderate bit-width (e.g., W8A8), it suffers from severe performance degradation under low-bit quantization (e.g., W4A8), especially for small-scale models that are more suitable for edge deployment. In this paper, we propose ProQuant, a novel weight-activation quantization-aware training (QAT) framework tailored for low-bit MLLMs. First, to align the limited finetuning dataset distribution with the pretrained dataset distribution, we propose a self-relabeling (SRL) scheme to resample the responses of the open-source multimodal dataset. Second, we are the first to take a decoupled view of multi-modal (MM) understanding and language modeling abilities. We propose a progressive block activation (PBA) mechanism to prioritize the MM understanding recovery. We also introduce a vision-sensitive factor \vec\tau that effectively identifies the MM-critical layers. Extensive experiments across various benchmarks, covering models with 2B-8B parameters, show that ProQuant significantly outperforms existing methods. For example, our W4A8 Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct improves average accuracy by impressively 6.6% and achieves performance comparable to full precision counterparts with only approximately 1% performance drop. Code is available at this https URL.

[NLP-18] SMART: State-based Multi Agent Reasoning Traces for Verification-oriented Problem-Solving

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决在上下文信息有限的复杂问题（如科学主张）中，因缺乏必要背景知识而导致推理能力受限的问题。其核心挑战在于如何有效获取并利用与问题解决方案相关且可信的知识以支持推理过程。该研究提出的解决方案——SMART多智能体框架，其关键在于通过捕捉问题情境中参与实体的隐式状态，利用多种大语言模型（LLM）结合结构化的角色驱动提示策略，系统性地构建多样化、互补性强且与解题高度相关的经验证实前提（premises）。该方法通过将前提知识锚定于真实世界可验证的事实，显著提升了推理性能，使在跨三个数据集的复杂科学主张验证任务中准确率最高提升20%，其中基于真实世界知识的锚定机制本身即可带来高达5%的性能增益，证明了知识真实性对推理有效性的重要作用。

点击查看摘要

Abstract:Complex problems with limited context, such as claims, require a means to obtain additional knowledge necessary for solution reasoning. We propose a multi-agent framework, SMART, to obtain knowledge through capturing the implicit state of participating entities in a problem context. SMART curates the state knowledge as diverse, complementary and solution-salient premises using a variety of LLMs and a structured role-based prompt strategy. Using knowledge from these real-world verified curated premises, SMART’s knowledge guided solution reasoning improves validation performance up to 20% on complex scientific claims spanning 3 datasets. We show that grounding premises in real-world knowledge is necessary and improves performance up to 5%.

[NLP-19] Knowing When to Teach: Learning from Teachable Prefixes in Multilingual Reasoning Distillation

【速读】： 该论文旨在解决多语言推理场景下基于策略自蒸馏（On-Policy Self-Distillation, OPSD）方法中存在的“教师漂移”（Teacher Drift）问题。当学生模型在低资源语言中产生中间步骤错误时，若教师模型仍以相同方式生成反馈，会逐渐跟随学生错误路径，导致错误累积并降低推理性能。其解决方案的关键在于提出可教的基于策略自蒸馏（Teachable On-Policy Self-Distillation, TOPSD），通过引入教师-学生似然比来识别教师开始偏离正确路径的节点（即漂移起点），并据此选择一个用于监督的前缀；随后验证该前缀是否能引导教师恢复正确答案，仅对通过验证的前缀实施蒸馏。该机制有效缓解了跨语言中因资源差异引发的教师漂移问题，在十种语言、三种模型规模的多语言数学推理任务上均显著优于传统OPSD，尤其在低资源和中等资源语言中表现更为突出。

作者: Jaewon Cho,Minseo Yoon,Jinyoung Park,Jinwoo Seo,Jaewon Chu,Alice Oh,Hyunwoo J. Kim
机构: KAIST(韩国科学技术院); Korea University(韩国大学)
类目: Computation and Language (cs.CL); Artificial Intelligence (cs.AI)
